newsitem.title: USA: Riviera Holdings to merge with new company.
newsitem.headline: Riviera Holdings to merge with new company.

text.p: Riviera Holdings Corp said Friday it had signed a non-binding letter of intent to merge with a new company owned by Allen Paulson, a thoroughbred owner and chief executive of Full House Resorts Inc.
At closing, each Riviera stockholder would receive $15 per share. Riviera said it would become wholly owned by Paulson.
Riviera said it could give no assurances that the merger agreement would be executed or consummated.

"The management team is looking forward to the prospect of working with Mr Paulson to grow the Riviera and other gaming prospects," Riviera Chairman and Chief Executive William Westerman said in a statement.
Riviera operates the Riviera Hotel and Casino, and through its wholly-owned subsidiary Riviera Gaming Management, operates the Four Queens Hotel and Casino.
